> Casa de Campo Resort and Villas is a luxury 7000 acre resort and residential community on the southeastern coast of the Dominican Republic, offering accommodations, dining, golf, and experiences across the property. It is known for world class golf, a full service marina, Altos de Chavón, and a private Caribbean lifestyle setting.
